- Long-press (500 ms) and contextmenu open a bottom sheet with the actions; the composer is fixed at the bottom and follows the keyboard through `visualViewport`. The phone 动态 tab keeps only system history.
- Resolve and Delete follow today's gates from #36178; once the #36186 + #36191 doors merge, members' ✓ on others' threads and Delete on their own comments follow automatically. No permission is widened here.
